column1: # Stage S9 K1b: the API's HTTP layer becomes crates/api/api_http_layer. The access tokens and
# opaque-token primitives, the middleware chain, the metrics and health surfaces, the realtime hub
# and the outbound retry move whole, each folder a module of the crate. Each module prefix is one
# `crate::` row scoped to the API source and one `api::` row scoped to the API package (integration
# tests, binaries); the folders that reach each other get `crate::` rows scoped to themselves
# first. Grouped use trees were split before the rows ran.
# Inside the new crate, scoped to the folders that become it, first: a file two rows of one prefix
# both reach takes the earlier row
